mapper.sql: select survey_id, survey_name, survey_desc, public_code, status, start_time, end_time, max_answers, allow_multi, access_pwd, theme_json, webhook_url, daily_limit, need_captcha, webhook_secret, view_count, answer_count, create_user_id, dept_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, null::varchar as owner_name, null::varchar as owner_nick_name from biz_survey

select s.survey_id, s.survey_name, s.survey_desc, s.public_code, s.status, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.max_answers, s.allow_multi, s.access_pwd, s.theme_json, s.webhook_url, s.daily_limit, s.need_captcha, s.webhook_secret, s.view_count, s.answer_count, s.create_user_id, s.dept_id, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.remark, u.user_name as owner_name, u.nick_name as owner_nick_name from biz_survey s left join sys_user u on u.user_id = s.create_user_id
mapper.delete: delete from biz_survey where survey_id in #{id}
mapper.update: update biz_survey set answer_count = coalesce(answer_count, 0) + 1, update_time = now() where survey_id = #{surveyId}
update biz_survey set view_count = coalesce(view_count, 0) + 1, update_time = now() where survey_id = #{surveyId}
update biz_survey set create_user_id = #{createUserId}, dept_id = #{deptId}, create_by = #{createBy}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where survey_id = #{surveyId}
